006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ICollectionValue;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.impl.SequenceTypeImpl;
012
013import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
014
015/**
016 * Supports
017 * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-31/#id-sequencetype-syntax">sequence
018 * type</a> testing.
019 */
020public interface ISequenceType {
021  /**
022   * A sequence type representing an empty sequence.
023   *
024   * @return the sequence type
025   */
026  @NonNull
027  static ISequenceType empty() {
028    return SequenceTypeImpl.empty();
029  }
030
031  /**
032   * Create new sequence type using the provide type and occurrence.
033   *
034   * @param type
035   *          the required sequence item type
036   * @param occurrence
037   *          the expected occurrence of the sequence
038   * @return the new sequence type
039   */
040  @NonNull
041  static ISequenceType of(
042      @NonNull IItemType type,
043      @NonNull Occurrence occurrence) {
044    return occurrence == Occurrence.ZERO
045        ? empty()
046        : new SequenceTypeImpl(type, occurrence);
047  }
048
049  /**
050   * Determine if the sequence is empty (if it holds any data) or not.
051   *
052   * @return {@code true} if the sequence is empty or {@code false} otherwise
053   */
054  boolean isEmpty();
055
056  /**
057   * Get the type of the sequence.
058   *
059   * @return the type of the sequence or {@code null} if the sequence is empty
060   */
061  @NonNull
062  IItemType getType();
063
064  /**
065   * Get the occurrence of the sequence.
066   *
067   * @return the occurrence of the sequence or {@code Occurrence#ZERO} if the
068   *         sequence is empty
069   */
070  @NonNull
071  Occurrence getOccurrence();
072
073  /**
074   * Get the signature of the function as a string.
075   *
076   * @return the signature
077   */
078  @NonNull
079  String toSignature();
080
081  /**
082   * Tests that a given collection value matches this sequence type.
083   *
084   * @param value
085   *          the collection value to test
086   * @return {@code true} if the value matches the expectations of this sequence
087   *         type or {@code false} otherwise
088   */
089  boolean matches(@NonNull ICollectionValue value);
090
091  /**
092   * Test if the provided sequence matches this sequence type.
093   *
094   * @param <T>
095   *          the Java type of the items contained within the sequence
096   * @param sequence
097   *          the sequence to test
098   * @return the sequence if the test passes
099   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
100   *           if the test fails because the sequence is not the required type
101   */
102  @NonNull
103  default <T extends IItem> ISequence<T> test(@NonNull ISequence<T> sequence) {
104    if (matches(sequence)) {
105      return sequence;
106    }
107    throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
108        null,
109        String.format("The argument '%s' is not a '%s'",
110            sequence.toSignature(),
111            toSignature()));
112  }
113
114  /**
115   * Test if the provided item matches this sequence type.
116   *
117   * @param <T>
118   *          the Java type of the items contained within the sequence
119   * @param item
120   *          the item to test
121   * @return the item if the test passes
122   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
123   *           if the test fails because the item is not the required type
124   */
125  @NonNull
126  default <T extends IItem> T test(@NonNull T item) {
127    ISequence<T> sequence = ISequence.of(item);
128    if (matches(sequence)) {
129      return item;
130    }
131    throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(
132        null,
133        String.format("The item '%s' is not a '%s'",
134            item.toSignature(),
135            toSignature()));
136  }
137}
